index.heading: Front matter — mandate identity
index.summary: Title block: Mastercard International Incorporated, mandate ID MCS-2026-R3, Part 1 of 2, applicable brands (Mastercard incl. Maestro and Debit Mastercard), version 1.2 Approved-Final, compliance deadline 2026-09-30.

index.heading: 1. Mandate Summary
index.summary: What the mandate is and its binding force: issued under the Mastercard Rules, binding on all licensed acquirers including JPMC Merchant Services. Requires support for MDES token-based transactions, revised interchange qualification, and enhanced Banknet routing for Debit Mastercard/Maestro. Full compliance by 2026-09-30; supersedes MCS-2024-R7 for MDES token routing and interchange qualification.

index.heading: 2. Scope and Affected Card Brands
index.summary: Brands and BIN ranges in scope: Mastercard Credit (all tiers), Debit Mastercard, Maestro, Mastercard Commercial. Prepaid is EXCLUDED from MDES token requirements but still subject to Part 2 interchange/routing changes. BIN ranges 510000-559999 and 600000-699999; token BINs 520000-529999 specifically in scope.

index.heading: 3. Brand Rules and Operational Constraints
index.summary: Section heading only — brand rules BR-01..BR-05 are in subsections 3.1-3.4.

index.heading: 3.1 MDES Token Handling
index.summary: BR-01: acquirers MUST NOT de-tokenize MDES tokens before forwarding to Banknet; stripping or substituting yields RC 14 declines. BR-02: Token Requestor IDs MUST be preserved in DE 48.66 through the full authorization chain, with DE 48.77 wallet indicator populated for wallet-sourced transactions.

index.heading: 3.2 Cardholder Verification Rules
index.summary: BR-03: contactless above USD 100.00 MUST request CVM per EMV Contactless Kernel C-3. Priority: Online PIN, Offline Enciphered PIN, Signature. No-CVM permitted for transit/toll MCCs only (4111, 4121, 4131, 7523). Result in DE 55 Tag 9F34.

index.heading: 3.3 Authorization Timeout and Fallback
index.summary: BR-04: on primary Banknet timeout beyond 4000ms the acquirer MAY try the secondary endpoint; the fallback MUST be logged with reason code T. On secondary timeout, forward to Mastercard STIP rather than declining at the acquiring host.

index.heading: 3.4 Decline Reason Code Updates
index.summary: BR-05: RC 55 on MDES token transactions now means 'Token Assurance Level insufficient', not legacy 'Incorrect PIN'. Host and merchant-facing decline engines MUST display 'Unable to process - please retry with chip card' for RC 55 on token transactions (BIN 520000-529999).

index.heading: 4. Certification and Conformance Requirements
index.summary: MAC Level 2 required before the deadline via Mastercard Connect, in three gates. C1 functional (MTS v8.4; 100% Category A, 85% Category B; ~4 weeks). C2 interoperability (1,000 traces incl. >=300 MDES token, >=100 fallback chip, >=50 Reg II, JSONL via the Testing API). C3 production validation (60-day monitoring of token decline rates, TRID population, DE 48.77 coverage; MAC revoked if not remediated in 30 days). Missing MAC L2 downgrades all Mastercard/Maestro traffic to Standard non-qualified interchange plus a 90-day remediation plan.

index.heading: 5. Compliance Deadline and Milestones
index.summary: Milestone table with dates and owners: MTS v8.4 harness 2026-04-15 (JPMC Merchant Tech); C1 complete 2026-06-15 (JPMC QA); C2 submission 2026-07-31 (JPMC + MCA); production deployment 2026-09-01 (JPMC Ops); C3 monitoring begins 2026-09-01 (MCA); COMPLIANCE DEADLINE 2026-09-30.
